reviews.text: Thank you, Mya! We're delighted to know you had a great experience with us at Sunset Animal Hospital. Your feedback truly brightens our day.

Previous review on Yelp. This is an update. They are terrible at filling prescriptions. I emailed Tuesday night for a prescription refill. No call or email telling me it was ready. But they did respond back to my email letting me know it’s been received and in progress. It’ll be ready within 24-48 hours. Today is Saturday. It’s been over 72 hours since the prescription refill request. I get here and they tell me it hasn’t been filled. To have a seat and they’ll get to working on it. These drops are made specifically for my frenchie so it’s not a simple refill. It has to be made and why I reach out so much ahead of time to get them so she’s not without her meds. Sunset a simple prescription refill should be easy work. I don’t know why they are struggling with the basics. Truly disappointing.
Thank you for sharing your experience with us! We're delighted to know that everything went smoothly during your visit. If there's anything else we can do for you or your pet, please let us know.

This place is beyond amazing, the staff blew me away so kind so patient and passionate. I was so scared because it’s the first time I’ve had any issues with my Ziggy but as soon as you walk through the door from the receptionist to my Dr. the warmth that was given touched my heart ♥️ I can’t thank these guys enough but I truly appreciate each one of you for taking care of my boy
Mid vet establishment

Went last night the tech was friendly but vet came in and hardly looked at my dog after he’s being treated for fleas and I asked for a full physical examination vet hardly looked at my Gussie. Wait was 3 hours which would be fine if he got a full examination.

Vet tech was nice and quick but doctor never showed. Literally waited over 2 hours, asked multiple times if the doctor was coming, was told yes, and they never came. My cat didn’t even get seen and I was one of the only people in the building. Wasted over 2 hours and they didn’t even say anything when I walked out the door!
Excellent and very fast working place, but pricey, but they get to what you need to do for ur pets

The level of care and service we received was truly beyond anything I could have expected. The moment I walked in, my dog was having a seizure, and the front office staff immediately rushed over, took him into their care, and began helping him. They quickly reassured me that he had been given medication, was sedated, and was finally calm.

Dr. Taylor Pit was incredibly caring, patient, and attentive to both my dog and our family. Sadly, my sweet boy didn’t make it, but I will never forget the compassion we received during his final moments. Everyone treated him with so much care until the very last second, and that means more to me than I can express.

I live in Katy, but if I ever have another pet emergency, I would absolutely return here. I cannot recommend this facility enough. Truly 10+ service and care.
Knowing that your visit went smoothly is exactly what we aim for, Lindsey. Thank you for sharing your experience with us. We look forward to seeing you and your pet again!

Knowing you had a positive experience with us, Marc, is exactly what we aim for. We loved having your pet visit us and are delighted to hear everything went smoothly. Thank you for sharing your feedback!

Rosco looks forward to his visits!
Staff, Tech, and Vets are awesome!
Very friendly staff, excellent service

Hi Jesus, we're disappointed to see your 1-star rating. Our team is committed to providing the best possible experience for our patients and clients, and we'd like to better understand what happened. If you'd be open to sharing more about your visit, please reach out to us directly. We value your feedback and would appreciate the opportunity to make things right.

This place will try to take advantage of the fact that you care about your pet. “What are you willing to pay?” Kind of place. Also, one lady that worked there saw me standing at the door as I pulled and Rang the door bell and just walked right passed it.
Netzdo, knowing you had a positive experience with us is exactly what we hope for. Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We look forward to seeing you and your pet again!
Knowing you had a positive experience with us, Vanessa, is exactly what we hope for. We loved having your pet visit and are here whenever you need us. Thank you for sharing your feedback!

I had to take my cat Mia for an emergency C-section, and everything went very well, thank God and all the wonderful staff. Unfortunately, the kittens didn't survive. I took them home, but after the operation, Mia rejected them and wouldn't nurse them, and they became very weak. There was nothing we could do. 😔 But Mia is fully recovered; everything was wonderful.

Knowing you had a positive experience with us, Lisandra, is exactly what we aim for. We're delighted to have been able to care for your pet and appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback. If there's anything else we can do for you or your furry friend, please let us know.
Knowing you had a positive experience with us, Jeremy, is exactly what we aim for. Thank you for trusting us with your pet's care. We look forward to seeing you both again!

I got here at 7 pm and at 9 was still not seen and still not even told anything and 3 times asked when my pet might be seen and they didn’t know because they only had one doctor on staff so at 915 I asked again and they said another hour ! Why wouldn’t they have just said you still will be here another hour . I said I’m leaving and they didn’t say a word because that didn’t care so I’m going to another emergency room! What a waste of my time and I have another pet at home alone while I wasted my time with a sick pet with me and a pet at home alone . I will never come back here

This place saved my cats life. I walked in at 9pm and they performed an emergency surgery within the next hour. I couldn’t be more thankful for their team. From start to finish they were amazing. They were transparent about pricing & I even ended up paying less than what I was originally quoted. Thank you!!

The service here is horrible. I called in yesterday and asked if they take emergencies as my 8 week old puppy had a seizure and was clearly in need of emergency care. They said yes and when I pulled up, the receptionist, an Asian man, was not welcoming at all. I was clearly distraught and in panic and he had no sense of urgency. There were maybe 3 other people in the lobby it was not busy at all. He proceeded to ask me questions about my name number email, etc and other things that had nothing to do with getting immediate care for my puppy. He put my brother and I in a waiting room with no other explanation or waiting time or instructions. We sat for 10-15 minutes while our puppy whined and cried in pain. I then went back to the front desk and respectfully asked if there is a wait time for us to be seen. I wasn’t being rude or rushing him I asked him for transparency as my dog clearly needed medical attention and if I couldn’t trust to receive that here in time, that we would leave and try somewhere for the sake of the puppy. He told me he didn’t know what the wait was I asked him if it’s only one doctor or something he said yes which should be communicated FIRST if your first priorities here are the well being of your customers pets. He then said it could be another 30 minutes or more but he would have someone come and check out our puppy while waiting for the doctor. I went back to the room and waited and realized he never moved or got up to tell anyone anything. I would not recommend bringing your pet here especially in a time of emergency. My brother brought his sick puppy here before and he said they literally did nothing to assist but was persistent on receiving a payment. 0/10 I would put 0 stars if I could. They should be ashamed of themselves don’t waste your time or money on this place.

New dog guy here (foster turned adoption) and probably a little paranoid... but i came home the other evening and found Ella had gotten into a bag of bully sticks, with at least two missing. I was afraid she swallowed one whole. It was after hours, and found Sunset Animal Hospital online and went in. The receptionists at the front counter were warm and friendly, took my info and had us wait in a clean and dog friendly waiting room. I was seen by the vet, Dr. Kim, about 10 or 15 minutes later. I explained Ella's story, and advised him my fears of maybe the bully stick causing internal damage or an intestinal blockage. The doctor was caring, empathetic and direct, advising me that x rays likely would not show anything. I brought a bully stick with us and showed him the treat... he suggested i give it to her and see how she eats it... We we did, and she started gnawing on it like a dog should. The doc told me that it looks like she knows how to eat them and he advised just to monitor her closely for distress, vomiting, pain, etc.. and bring her back if she showed any signs/symptoms. i went back to reception and I overheard one of the employees on the phone with Dr. Kim . I heard her say, "a consultation?" and the doctor apparently gave her instructions. When she hung up, she told me, "No charge". I was shocked, and very grateful. I actually got choked up at this display of kindness. Being a new dog owner, I probably would have agreed to anything the doctor had advised, kind of an easy "mark" so to speak... but nope, they were honest, up front, kind, understanding, and refused to take advantage of my paranoia - even though i basically was begging them to! This is my go-to from now on, and I would recommend this place for anyone like me who worries a lot about their furry family members!! Thank you Dr. Kim and Sunset Animal Hospital!

I brought my 3 one week old kittens here for various reasons (concern for aspiration, constipation, and diarrhea). The staff addressed my problems quickly and had me in front of a vet within minutes. My kittens were assessed, treated, and returned to me within 30-45 minutes and the vet and staff members educated me and answered all my questions. They all did an absolutely outstanding job and really put me at ease related to the care of my kittens. On top of that, they did everything they could to keep the cost down without me asking, truly a group of individuals who are in it for the love of animals and to take care of our furry friends. Definitely would recommend.

Sunset Animal Hospital is an excellent place to take your pet. My experience was amazing; everyone was very attentive and kind. My dog ​​was sad, and they treated her right away. In less than two hours, she was already improving. The prices are reasonable.
Thank you for everything! 100% recommended.
Laura, we're thrilled to hear you had such a positive experience with us at Sunset Animal Hospital. Thank you for trusting us with your pet's care. We look forward to seeing you both again soon!
Came with a stray kitten at like 3 am and Amanda helped get him all settled and dewormed for us! Supper friendly and cost effective had a great time

UPDATE: Odin has made a full recovery!!

I just have to say this place was great. Aside from a bit of a wait which is completely understandable given the personable and hospitable nature of the Dr and nurses. My puppy came in with suspected Parvo which came back positive and we were strapped for cash, they helped absolutely in every way possible by giving information and alternate routes for outpatient care. We only had enough for the exam and test and they waived the exam fee for being first time patients with a purchase, so we were able to get the baseline of what he needed. He’s not out of the woods yet but we’re hoping and praying he pulls through. My neighbor had to put her puppy down and they were absolutely so sweet and caring and kind. I would recommend this place to any one.
My first time at Sunset, with Dr. Ellender was great. Staff were amazing and facility was super clean and organized. Very impressive.!

Do not take your pet here! They will recommend unneeded services to fill their pockets. I had nothing but a very horrible, unpleasant experience with my dog who went in for an unknown injury to his leg. The vet will start throwing a lot of medical jargon at you to make it seem like “they are covering everything possibly wrong.” The vet techs are even worse with no bedside manner and will be quick to throw an estimate in your face for unneeded services. After sitting in a small room on a hard bench for over three hours with little to no communication from them, I was met with a bill that was different than what I was told and formatted in a very confusing manner (I had to go back and forth with the vet tech over 15 minutes about this and she completely contradicted herself multiple times.) The manager on sight (Nathan I believe is his name) clearly has no experience running a 24/7 animal hospital and will fake care when you ask to speak with the person in charge. They tried to tell me my dog needed to be put under which required intubation for simple X-rays. When I started doing my own research on the hospital and read some of the other MANY similar reviews on here, red flags immediately went off and I began questioning everything they told me. Not to mention they have been in business over 14 years and are not BBB accredited (what a joke!) Due your own due diligence and don’t take any pet you love and care about here!

Great place if you have an urgent issue.
But if you are using them for a wellness clinic just know you may or may not be seen when you have an appointment.  So plan accordingly.  After using them for an emergency over the weekend I was excited about using them for all of our vetcare needs.  They are not close, so the time commitment is about 45-minutes each way.  When we got there today for his checkup and vaccines I was told that the only Dr working today is in the middle of a procedure and they weren't sure how long it would take.  So I could either wait or I could drop him off and come back later to pick him up.  Neither of those were workable options.  It sure would have been nice for them to call me and tell me that the Dr had to go into an emergency and wouldn't be available for our appointment time.  Then it would have been my choice to drive all the way over there an wait, or reschedule.
Stephanie was super fast and helpful and made sure my dog Leo was taken care of! Thank you so much!!!!
Loved the experience super nice staff. For the price I feel more should have been done . But over all everything worked out .
Is the second time with this hospital and the team and the service are amazing, they treat my cats in a special way!!! Thank you
Thank you, Gess Pedraza, for your 5-star rating! We appreciate your trust in us for your pet's veterinary care. If you have any further feedback or need assistance, feel free to reach out.

My husband and I took our puppy here early in the morning after we awoke to her acting funny. Sunset was great, they took us as a walk in and set us up in a room right away. We saw a vet within 10 minutes of walking in the door. They waived the exam fee for us since we were new to the clinic. Overall great experience and they took care of our pet.

Yesterday, my indoor outdoor cat who I hadn’t seen for three days, came home and had obviously been in a fight or hit by a car. I wasn’t sure which one it was in the middle of the afternoon and I called my vet and they told me that their vet had already left and no they couldn’t see them so I called Sunset cause our cat was rushed to Sunset and they took care of her right away. She was pretty bad off had a fever. They had to sedate her to clean her up and she’s doing better now I know that’s can’t be all things to all people and they have lives, but some of our regular vets could spend the last hour of the day taking care of the emergencies instead of saying no to regular patients praises to Sunset for being there and taking care of my cats and the doctor calling me twice and letting me know what was going on I give them an A+, Dr. Joe and A+ and the staff and A+ for their commitments to animals and their people.

Very nice place. I went at 2am and was exhausted because my dogs were sick. I was immediately put into a room. The staff was friendly. The service was fast and I didn't spend a fortune. They understood what I needed. You really helped my Sasha girl! She's much better and we went to one of the vets you recommended.too They were good too but, that's another review. Lol Thank you so much!!
I was able to schedule an appointment and get in the following day and the vet was on time. He was able to help my dog’s anxiety to thunderstorms.
Service was quick, as soon as I walked in. I truly appreciate how kind and helpful the lady in the front desk treated us.

Where to begin.  I’ve been a client for years!  I’ve steadily seen the service go down.  I’ve had blankets lost from boarding, a dog with a gaping wound not seen due the front desk associate giving preference to others or being upset that I asked for an update on when he’d be seen.  She was younger and very immature.  Finally, they provided expired flea prevention.  That was the last straw.  I’ll never go back.  Ask anyone who’s worked there too, eventually, they realize the culture there is very bad and so they leave.  There are much better vets out there!

Amanda was such a huge help!! We brought in a stray cat to get quickly checked up and she provided us with great resources as well as informed us on how to keep this little kitten safe & healthy. Not only that, but she was very sweet & caring with the little kitten.
Had a great experience taking my fur baby in to get checked out. The service was professional and the staff really cared for my baby. Will recommend to others.

My nutty kitty, Milo, caught a bat on my balcony! They gave him his vaccine, and is safe and doing well. You can tell this is a staff of animal lovers. They always give expert care and advice for caring for our fur babies. And they are always open!

Staff was friendly and urgent when we arrived. Dr Arnold and the nurses were friendly, diligent, and made me feel comfortable through the entire process. Hopefully I don’t have to come here again but will be first choice in the event I need to.

Vet was very helpful. HOWEVER- we were sent to Gulf Coast veterinary to consult a neurologist. They did not have one available for the holiday weekend. But they kept her and provided very expensive care that I believe could have been provided at Sunset.

I brought a mommy cat (Bobby)in to Sunset Dog and Cat Hospital with a skin laceration that she started to scratch. I thought the injury was from another cat but was informed that it was small tumor. I was provided what medication she was going to get and instructed about her treatment at home. Staff was very professional and friendly. I would highly recommend Sunset Dog and Cat hospital to anyone. Great work ❗️

Staff was amazing here. My mom, sister and I came in with our dog Blue to put her down as her time was up. The staff made the whole process extremely easy and stress free and were very considerate with our girl.
Easy to make appointments, the staff is always friendly and my cat is doing very well. This is a great place to bring your pets!

They were amazing from the first call with Elisabeth to the tech’s and doctor. I’m sorry I can’t remember the names of everyone, but they were amazing because my dog had got injured and I was so scared because I’m a dog sitter. And the owner was away on a cruise and did not have access to Wi-Fi so I had to take full responsibility, but they calm my nerves and took care of the dog and gave her the very best treatment. They were great ATV reassuring me everything would be okay and amazing in a crisis as I was very concerned and scared I would definitely suggest you to take your dog to them.

Thank you, Yvonne, for your wonderful 5-star review! We're thrilled to hear that you had a positive experience with us at Sunset Animal Hospital. We appreciate your trust in us for your pet's veterinary care.

The vet and staff here are amazing! My cat Whiskey came in with a recurrent urinary issue. They saw Whiskey immediately, and the vet spent time explaining everything to me. I left Whiskey to be observed overnight. The vet called me later in the afternoon and spent a long time with me on the phone. He was really patient, knowledgeable and kind. He answered every question I had. I could not recommend this place more!
My dog was very sick and the vet took good care of him!  Highly recommend! ❤️

We came here to have my dog evaluated for blood in her stool and waited for two hours without being seen. We checked in and were put in a room after about 30 minutes only to sit and wait there without a single update. I understand people are walking in with high priority animals who are in critical condition, however there was no communication from the front desk staff. We had to reach out to see what our expected wait time was, as the receptionist played on her Alienware computer, and received pretty rude responses. This was a very dissatisfying experience, and my dog agrees. I could write this review long enough for you to read while you wait at this place, but I’ll just end it here.
Thank you, Daphne, for the 5-star rating! We greatly appreciate your support!

Went to sunset today bc my little dog was having booty problems. Dr. pitt and her assistant jennifer took care of my pet. They were both so sweet and handle my dog with lots of care. Both were very informative on how to go along with my pets treatment plan. This was my first time here ever. Very thankful to these 2 ladies for making my experience amazing. Would highly recommend

When it comes to 24/7 veterinary care they are efficient, kind and detailed.   My dog is hospitalized after a couple of orthopedic surgical complications.   I believe they offer quality care and are on top of taking care of him.   They are so much more reasonably priced, too, than other area Veterinary ERs.  They call with updates and progress reports.  Sunset has been around a lot of years, and there is a reason why...

Thank goodness for the vet and emergency services at Sunset.  The staff immediately acted and rushed my 2 new puppies. The vets recommendation for treatment and costs were very affordable. I’d highly recommend the business and services they provide.
Dr Wood is excellent!!  The wait time could improve.

Amanda was absolutely amazing during my visit to the vet! She was so helpful, caring, and made the entire experience feel comfortable and stress-free. You can truly tell she loves what she does and cares about the animals and their owners. On top of that, she was just the sweetest and so cute! The service was excellent from start to finish, and because of Amanda, I will definitely be coming back. I would definitely recommend her to anyone looking for a caring and attentive vet nurse. Thank you for making such a great experience for me and my pet!
Thank you to Dr. Woods and Tara. You guys were amazing, caring and knowledgeable. My Sam is doing better today.
My sick 18 year old cat wasn’t eating and lethargic. The staff and Drs. Have been treating her and making her eat and happy again and I feel confident they will figure out what’s wrong!

I took in a little kitten I found, and Dr. Lopez and vet tech Stephanie gave him absolutely exceptional care.  They were incredibly loving, gentle, and attentive from the moment we arrived.  You can tell they truly care about the animals and the people who bring them in.  The entire experience felt warm, compassionate, and professional.  From the first call I made by Anthony, and the receptionist also were amazing.  First-class veterinary care in every way - I'm so grateful for the kindness and expertise they showed this 1.15 lb kitten.  I highly recommend.
Both vets I have seen here with middle of the night emergencies were very kind, knowledgeable and practical.

Literally the best vet. The care is so good and the staff is so sweet and kind. If you’re looking for a new vet I highly recommend. I’ve had such bad experiences with previous vets too this is a breath of fresh air.
Compassionate, thoughtful, professional care. It’s a lot of money but that’s kind of the going rate, not significantly out of line.

The reason for my low rating is because I feel like I was way overcharged for medicines For example, one medicine was furosemide a very, very cheap medication. I was charged $35 for about six of them So this makes me wonder about the rest of the charges, based on that I was overcharged on everything
Walked in, only waited about 30 minutes. They listen well when diagnosing my pets.

Brought in my kitten around 10 pm because he was lethargic, breathing heavily and not eating they prescribed antibiotics and made some suggestions . We tried feeding him the next morning around 5am he began choking struggling to breathe I rushed him to the hospital which is literally 1  MINUTE away the kitten was still conscious while we were outside waiting to get let in. Ringing the door ring multiple times NO ONE WAS AT THE FRONT DESK while we’re outside trying to save our kitten about 3 to 7 min pass finally someone lets us in. They take the kitten, about 10 min later he’s pronounced dead and they had the audacity to say he was dead upon arrival. I’m devastated

I took my 8 month old female miniature scnoodle here to be spayed. I was very nervous as I had never had any of my dogs spayed or neutered before. Dr. Wesson and the staff were very supportive and reassuring. I appreciate all their loving care to my dog.
The front desk staff and the entire crew at Sunset are the BEST!!  Love Dr. Woods and so grateful to have found her to care for our furbabies!

What happened in my situation was months ago, but is a bit overdue. I was running around going to hospitals that could help with my puppies. I was sent to this one, and seeing the (at least) 4 star rating gave us some hope that we could get our puppies some help. They needed some blood transfusions and some deworming. They wanted to charge $10k on the spot. We didn't have that on hand, so I was attempting to ask for some leeway, but the nurse seemed to get annoyed with the situation. She was upset that we didn't have the money, and not on the puppies conditions. She kept insisting that they needed to stay over night to be watched over. The moment I asked if it was possible to give me tips to watch over them myself and just do the blood transfusions, oh boy. First of all, she started stammering as if yes that's an option, but she definitely didn't want to. (It wasn't an 'oh I'm sorry that's not possible because there are certain procedures to follow' but rather 'no because then we can't charge you for the stay') Second, she immediately started going on a rant about how she's been a nurse for over 24 years. Lady, I DON'T CARE. If anything, that's nothing to brag about because people like that tend to skip over the basics because of how 'experienced' they are. I just wanted to get them treated. Then she said that the puppies levels needed attention, but that medication can suffice. We were still charged a $2-3k, but with the hope that we can get them treated. They both ended up dying within 24 hours after the visit. 24 HOURS!!! That was nothing! There were no mentions of hours. She said at least weeks! And to put more salt into it, they kept sending letters (postcards) practically every other day about getting their vaccines. No calls or checks about how they were doing, or for any follow-ups. It got so out of hand I had to call and tell them that they didn't make it, and to stop sending vaccine reminders, and what did the receptionist say? 'Kay' and hung up. At least give me the generic 'I'm so sorry that happened'. I understand that they probably get a lot of bad situations that don't turn out well, but seriously? I'm sure it wasn't exactly heartbreaking for Ms. 24 years, but have some compassion. I was already attached to them and ready to have them become part of the family. I'm glad so many people have had good experiences, and were able to take their babies home good as new. I based my expectations on those reviews, but it's unfortunate that we didn't get that life saving experience. One experience shouldn't define it, but I'm personally not going to be returning here.

Thank you to the night crew including the Dr. and Stephanie and the sweet girl I met upfront. Valentino! was not doing well and needed oxygen and we brought him home and followed up care and he is doing much better now. We always use our regular vet, but they were full and we always know we can rely on Sunset if needed.
Dr. Enrique has an incredible touch—my cat relaxed instantly, and somehow the whole experience was more satisfying than expected. 5 stars.

My poor cat, Ellie, got her lower fang torn and angled in her mouth. Took her in and was immediately pulled back. I was so worried for her and the cost of everything. I panicked average cost of dental surgery and got CareCredit just in case for the amount (usually dental surgery is between $1,000 and $3,000).

The doctor came back with her and told me that they were able to pull it cleanly with the root intact and all she needed from there was medication for healing over the next week. I was very thankful for their help and relieved Ellie did not need any surgery. I was ready to stay there for however long it was going to be bringing a charger and my work from the office.

The vet tech, who was with me start to finish, came back with the cost of services and I was already ready to pay at least $1,000. They said they waved the fee and I only needed to pay for her medication. I couldn't help but cry with the amount of relief I felt with everything. They took care of not only my Ellie, but me as well. The whole process start to finish was less than an hour.

I cannot thank each and every staff member that helped Ellie out and the amount of relief for her and myself. I highly recommend going for any service needed. I wish I could remember the names of the vet tech and the doctor that took the time to make this whole stressful situation easy.
Clean Environment, professional staff, reasonable prices, plenty of parking space
Staff is great, the wait time was quick! The nurses and Doctors explained everything as it’s being done. My pup is doing wonderful.
Great place!
My dog was twin here after eating cooked chicken bones and was taken care of with wonderful care, he is now back home and resting but I could not be more grateful for the staff here.
Great staff and vets. I love Dr Wesson as she is super knowledgeable, compassionate, and helpful. I have brought many cats to her for help (I rescue a lot) and she has always been a great!
They took great care of my 6 month old puppy. The team at Sunset was very professional and attentive during my puppy's stay with them. Thanks

Lovely personnel ! We went to a different place at first and they wrongfully diagnosed our baby and were charging over a thousand dollars to wait until a weekday to get her SURGERY that she didn’t even need. We only spent if anything 30 minutes in the hospital and spent on nothing else otherthan an injection. These guys actually care about your pets and I’m so thankful that they helped us out. ❤️

I've been going to Sunset Animal Hospital when needed since it was on Sunset. It has since been bought by a corporate veterinarian company (as is the case with most every vet these days), but Sunset has still continued to have good service and reasonable prices. It is very competitive for 24 hour emergency veterinary service. but I've been going most recently to get surgery for my senior dog. Dr. Lane has been helpful with doing the surgeries successfully and helping to manage aftercare.
Dr.Cho, Andrea, and all the staff are so amazing. They helped my baby during the scariest two days of her life and I am forever grateful!!!!

I brought my kitten in close to midnight after a really scary accident, with my toddler with me, and Dr. Cho, Daniel and the team were amazing from the second we walked in. He was calm, confident, and immediately made me feel like everything was going to be okay.

They took such good care of my kitten through a traumatic situation, and I truly believe they saved her. They were also so kind and patient with me and my child, which meant a lot in that moment.

They also gave me several follow up calls to give me updates and texts the same night. It was very comforting knowing she was in good hands.

I’m really grateful for them and wouldn’t go anywhere else in an emergency.
Staff was very knowledgeable and welcoming, they attended me right away and answered any questions I had.

First time at Sunset and both my husband and I were so impressed with the service, starting with the front desk love the doctor and tech. Max our small dog walked straight to doctor, he wasn’t nervous or anxious. We will board him for a week and know that Max will be in good hands.
Friendly office staff. Not too long of a wait time. Vets were gentle and friendly with my cat.
I received great service from Dr. Wood, the assistant as well as the receptionist.

I was told my dog had an impacted tooth that needed to be surgically removed. The next morning the vet called me at work even though she was told not to me at work, but to call my spouse at home.  The vet interrupted my online class to tell me my dog was actually terminally ill with cancer, and he would likely die in a couple of months.  I asked how she could go from saying he had an impacted tooth to saying he was terminally ill. She admitted that his tooth had literally come off in her hand with no resistance.  She said she had seen a lot of this cancer before and knew that's what this was.  She charged me over $1500 and refused to refund any or part of the money.  They had no suitable pain management for that level of cancer but told me I could return with my dog in a few days when they were stocked. When I brought him back a week later in obvious pain, the staff kept us in the waiting room over eight hours.
